title: Independently audit the PR5627 interface and complete recursive invoice
body:
A separate implementation confirms the **emitted PR5627 interface, complete recursive invoice and unique raw crossing**. It reads the final word and caller as data and imports no predecessor constructor, local verifier or pricing engine. All 565,504 local matrix coefficients agree. The complete bill has 66,546 paid calls, 12,958 targets and rank-mass surplus 760. This is audit evidence for the existing conditional claim; it supplies no new kappa.

[Audit argument and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e994710938846bc2f6f44d2b6fc0c926036cedc5/research/pr5627-interface-invoice-audit/PROOF.md), [separate verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e994710938846bc2f6f44d2b6fc0c926036cedc5/research/pr5627-interface-invoice-audit/verify.py), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e994710938846bc2f6f44d2b6fc0c926036cedc5/research/pr5627-interface-invoice-audit/RESULT.json), [external pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e994710938846bc2f6f44d2b6fc0c926036cedc5/research/pr5627-interface-invoice-audit/SOURCE-CONTEXT.json). Base: canonical main 6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63, priority 7.

The dense integer interpreter tracks binary denominators, all public inputs, chart nesting, COPY preconditions and owned lifetimes. It confirms the combined effect of the five boundary changes, nine independent splits and two preparations in the final word. The removed H2 target is absent from the recomputed helper inventory. A separate rational logarithm/exponential series engine proves the raw crossing lies in (0.00310440547057, 0.00310440547058). Its derivative bound is strictly negative throughout [0,0.0034].

The source is [PR #5627](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5627), exact head ed4dc88a09a7d201971f6603b8c2074e95dd9c32: [emitted word](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ed4dc88a09a7d201971f6603b8c2074e95dd9c32/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/WORD.json.gz), [proof and attribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ed4dc88a09a7d201971f6603b8c2074e95dd9c32/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/PROOF.md). The [literal controller](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63/research/p104-productive-controller/CONTROLLER.json) is pinned separately. Credit Ali Romman's helper/basis composition, flyingviper's relay, Scratch-net's preparation, Pierre-Loic Doulcet's cascade, and the retained Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and source contributors. This audit claims none of those constructions.

Normal and optimized registered checks, committed-byte checks, official export integrity and Git-free optimized replay pass. Six controls reject a missing ADD, wrong SCALE, public erasure, missing owned CLEAR, an unremoved H2 target and a missing idle.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr5627-interface-invoice-audit
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Expected markers: `PASS_PR5627_INTERFACE_INVOICE_AUDIT` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Native phases, physical caller execution, compiler and outer conditions are outside this audit. INIT/CLEAR use the inherited owned-erasure contract: ten CLEARs discard a nonzero row. The final zero owned outputs do not prove restoration of arbitrary dirty inputs. The five framework assumptions and helper-endpoint contract remain. No full source-history ancestry, independent human or proof-kernel check is claimed; the checkout is shallow. The selected frontier is unchanged. [Released review handoff and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19185790). Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
